subject: Sherwood renewal + capacity addendum — PO, tax evidence, and net terms alignment
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@sherwood.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@sherwood.io>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity add-on — initial request

Hi Karthik,

We reviewed the usage for this quarter and would like to proceed with the renewal plus an immediate capacity add-on (approx +200k tokens / month). Finance wants a clean path for PO issuance and needs to confirm tax paperwork (we're a US entity but may have foreign entity invoicing later). Also, can we move to Net-45 for this renewal term? Our procurement team prefers a single PO for the renewal + add-on.

Can you confirm:
- The total renewal invoice amount to include on the PO (with the add-on)
- Whether Redwood can accept a Net-45 term for this contract period
- Any tax forms you need from us (W-9 or W-8 variant)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement | Sherwood Systems
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@sherwood.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add-on — initial request

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and congrats on the usage growth. Quick notes and next steps below.

1) Price/PO amount
- I will send an itemized renewal quote (renewal base + one-time prorated add-on charge) by EOD today so you can drop that exact amount into the PO.

2) Net terms
- Net-45 is acceptable pending standard credit review and the PO being issued as the invoice reference. Finance typically requires PO + signed SOW/Order Form. Kimberly (cc'd) will confirm the credit check cadence.

3) Tax forms
- For US invoicing we generally need a W-9 from Sherwood. If you expect non-US invoicing for any entity, we will need the appropriate W-8 variant.

Attachments: I will include a quick checklist and a link to our payment instructions.

Would you be available for a 20-minute call tomorrow at 10am PT to align on PO fields and billing contact? If not, I can coordinate asynchronously.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@sherwood.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add-on — initial request

Hi Elena — Kimberly from Finance here. Quick clarifying notes so we can get procurement everything they need: 

- PO contents: please include the Redwood Order Form number (I'll provide when the quote is sent) and the billing entity name exactly as Sherwood's legal entity appears on your W-9.
- Net-45: we can approve Net-45 for this renewal if the PO references the Order Form and the PO is received before the renewal date. We will run a short credit validation (usually 1 business day).
- Tax docs: W-9 is sufficient for US domestic billing. If Sherwood will invoice via a different foreign legal entity later, please provide the corresponding W-8 and entity documentation.

If you want, send the PO directly to billing@redwood.ai and cc me.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@sherwood.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@sherwood.io>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add-on — initial request

Hi Kimberly/Karthik — thanks. Per your instructions attached the PO and our W-8 (Sherwood has a US subsidiary but we prefer to invoice from our international entity this cycle). We included the Redwood Order Form field and the contact for our AP team.

Attachments: Sherwood_PO_June2026.pdf (PO), Sherwood_W8-BEN.pdf (tax form)

Please confirm receipt and whether anything else is required for Net-45 approval.

Regards,
Elena
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@sherwood.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add-on — PO and tax docs received

Elena — received the PO and W-8, thank you. A couple of operational items before we close out: 

- Net-45: finance cleared the credit validation; Net-45 is approved for this term.
- Invoice routing: billing@redwood.ai will generate the renewal invoice referencing PO SHW-06-2026. Expected invoice date: first business day after renewal effective date.
- Tax paperwork: W-8-BEN is on file. We flagged a missing signature on page 2 — can you confirm if Sherwood can re-send a signed copy? If resubmitting will delay the invoice, we can proceed with the PO on Net-45 while awaiting signed W-8, but any cross-border tax withholding will be dealt with in the next billing cycle if needed.

Next steps: Karthik will share the final quote and Order Form ID by EOD Monday so you have the exact numbers for your records.

Thanks and we'll keep this moving.

Jonas Weber
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

- Sherwood_PO_June2026.pdf (application/pdf, 124 KB)
- Sherwood_W8-BEN.pdf (application/pdf, 92 KB)
